title: Upcountry wildfire rebuild program
summary: On June 5, a budget amendment passed with eight ayes and one recusal, directing up to $3 million to Maui Economic Opportunity Inc. for an Upcountry wildfire rebuild pilot program. The county expects to partner with a local nonprofit to run the grant program. The money was first approved in committee in April, and the plan aims to help upcountry residents on a fixed income, uninsured, or underinsured.
